construction: Construction A — AGGREGATE net-flow state: a multi-day (L=7 UTC-day) net-flow z-state on the USDC-ETHEREUM primary issuer series (frozen all-class minter netting), consumed as a CONDITIONING-ONLY state over the frozen Binance panels. Two declared outcome-blind netted variants (V1 NEW-FLOAT-NET, V2 CCTP-NETTED) are declared below as sensitivity arms; the anchor series is the frozen full-coverage series, never a silently netted one.
mechanism: The issuer-contract net-flow state is a slowly-moving aggregate of primary-market issuance and redemption on the USDC-ETHEREUM float, measured at census grade from finalized FiatToken logs (C9 supply-delta identity enforced per day). The proposal makes NO forcing claim: 'new dollars entering must buy crypto' is invalid and not repairable, and is not this mechanism. Reverse causality (price moves causing issuance) is conceded as not fully identifiable; direction of any measured relation is an empirical D2 output. The question posed is strictly incremental-information: AFTER removing price momentum, OI/funding dead forms, a tape-fitted issuance proxy and every measured-dead exogenous-clock form (controls X1-X4), does the residual variation of the multi-day net-flow z-state contain repeatable information about later panel returns? A multi-day sum is used because single-day issuer nets are dominated by event-count lumpiness (isolated multi-billion-unit days against a much smaller typical magnitude), so only the multi-day state can plausibly carry a regime-like conditioning signal rather than day-level event noise. The sign convention in the decision rule is declared a priori as this arm's identity (expansion state -> long panel book, contraction state -> short panel book, deadband flat); it is a declared arm definition, not a claimed causal direction, and D2's null battery must move the signal for the arm to be valid at all.

formula.primary_series: n_t = net USDC units for UTC day t from research/control/crypto_ng3_run/day_rows_usdc_ethereum.json field 'net' (USDC-ETHEREUM only; = SUM(Mint) - SUM(Burn) over ALL FiatToken minter classes per the frozen C5 rule; C9 identity_ok required for every consumed day; unit = USDC at 6dp).
formula.state: S_t = sum_{k=0..6} n_{t-k}   (L = 7 UTC days, t ranges over panel days)
formula.standardization: W_t = {S_{t-63}, ..., S_{t-1}} (63 prior values of the same overlapping statistic, strictly before t; PIT-only). mu_t = mean(W_t); sigma_t = sample std(W_t, ddof=1). z_t = (S_t - mu_t) / sigma_t. z_t is decidable only if all 7 base days present, all 63 prior S values present, and sigma_t > 0.
formula.decision_variable: e_t = +1 if z_t >= +0.75; e_t = -1 if z_t <= -0.75; e_t = 0 otherwise. Threshold 0.75 is a single value fixed a priori at proposal time; no threshold search, no grid, no re-tuning at any later stage.
formula.variant_V1_NEW_FLOAT_NET: n_t^{V1} = n_t + burn_t^{0x55fe002aeff02f77364de339a1292923a15844b8} (re-add the excluded one-sided redemption stream; equivalently net flow excluding that address's burns). Same S/z/e machinery.
formula.variant_V2_CCTP_NETTED: n_t^{V2} = n_t - (mint_t^{CCTP} - burn_t^{CCTP}) where CCTP class = 0xfd78ee919681417d192449715b2594ab58f5d002 from the frozen minter_table.json. Same S/z/e machinery.

decision_rule: At each panel day t with decidable z_t: target book exposure e_t (+1/0/-1) on the equal-weight frozen Binance panel book, gross cap 1.0, symbol cap 0.10, stress tier 2.0 + break-even margin (plan sec 7). Availability per C8: decision_time = max(event_block_ts of events inside the state window) + 768s <= t 23:59:59.999999Z + 768s <= t+1 00:12:48Z (>= 2-epoch finality, conservative; measured serving latency p95 4.5s is negligible against this buffer). Entry = close of the first daily panel bar whose close timestamp >= decision_time, i.e. close of panel day t+1; no same-day information path exists. Holding H = 3 days close-to-close (exit at close of panel day t+1+3). A decision is taken ONLY if the full holding window [t+1 .. t+1+H] lies inside a single fold; otherwise the state is flat (force-flat at fold boundary). Decisions falling on the 4 C10 NET_EXTREME excluded days (2025-08-28, 2025-09-18, 2025-10-14, 2025-10-16) are not consumed by D2 (excluded from training/validation per frozen C10 rule) while the state itself is still computed and reported. The margin day 2026-08-22 is census coverage, never a decision or holding day. Costs: frozen crypto band schedule charged once per fill plus funding; F1 is financing-inclusive worst-case round-trip (P-21). Direction is the declared arm identity; the sign-inverted form is NOT this arm and would require a separately declared proposal consuming its own trial identity.
lookback: L = 7 UTC days for the net-flow sum; 63 prior values of S for PIT standardization (mu_t, sigma_t). First decidable panel day = panel-day index 70 = 2025-10-31 (needs 7 base days + 63 prior S values). No other lookback exists in this proposal.
holding_window: H = 3 days, close-to-close on the daily panel bars (entry close t+1 -> exit close t+4). Force-flat at fold boundary; no decision whose window crosses a fold boundary.
universe: Frozen Binance panels only — the existing S4 target set, unchanged. No new symbol, no panel edit. Equal-weight book subject to gross cap 1.0 and symbol cap 0.10.
turnover_estimate: Data-free analytic null bound (no price or flow series was computed by this proposal lane): under the null z ~ N(0,1), P(e_t != 0) = 2*Phi(-0.75) ~= 0.4533; an upper bound on exposure-change rate is therefore <= 0.4533 changes per panel-symbol-day (every in-state day a change, out-state days flat-to-flat). Expected realized turnover is materially lower because the 7-day overlapping sum makes state runs persistent (adjacent days share 6 of 7 base days). Measured turnover is reported at D2; the arm must additionally survive the F1 financing-inclusive worst-case round-trip ceiling measured at P2 on the frozen funding/cost bands.
missing_data_rule: Issuer side: a day with a missing day-row or identity_ok=false makes n_t MISSING; S_t is MISSING if any of its 7 base days is MISSING; z_t is MISSING unless W_t is complete (63 values) and sigma_t > 0. Nothing is ever zero-imputed or forward-filled (the USDT-ETHEREUM 339 zero-event days are a declared sparse stratum, never zero-imputed into any total — and are not in this state at all: the anchor is USDC-ETHEREUM-only). MISSING state -> flat, no decision consumed. Panel side: a symbol with a missing bar at an entry or exit close is skipped for that decision (no substitution, no backfill); the book remains equal-weight over present symbols. Warmup days before 2025-10-31 produce no decisions and consume no trials.
falsifier: The arm is killed (D2 kill, no scored cell) if ANY of: (a) X1: pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs the full crypto inventory, explicitly including the NG2 dead-form 29-shape panel triad; (b) X2: the anchor is a relabelled OI/funding dead form (OILEV-V2 / NG2 dead-form shadow set) — surviving the rho bar but structurally identical still dies; (c) X3: a tape-fitted issuance proxy (fitted from price/tape alone) subsumes the state — if the on-chain state adds no incremental information beyond the proxy, the census adds nothing and dies; (d) X4: the surviving signal is reproduced by clock-only conditioning or day-of-week geometry (Q-7 / NG1 killer class); (e) X5: delayed-state and shuffled nulls fail to move the signal (any INVALID-NULL verdict); (f) F1: the financing-inclusive worst-case round-trip ceiling at P2 exceeds what the frozen cost bands leave chargeable; (g) fold population: any fold with < 20 eligible (non-flat, non-excluded) decisions is not populated, and an unpopulated fold blocks eligibility; (h) sign instability: if the measured profitable sign differs across folds beyond what the null band allows, the declared sign convention is regime-labeling, not a state property — the arm dies as declared (the sign-inverted result is a different arm, not a rescue). Expected modal terminal is a measured D2 kill; a kill is the system working.
declared_controls: X1 ANCESTRY RHO: pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the full crypto inventory, explicitly including the NG2 dead-form 29-shape panel triad (the complete NG2 declared shadow set).
X2 OI/FUNDING DEAD FORMS: OILEV-V2 and the NG2 dead-form shadow set — the anchor must not be a relabelled OI/funding state.
X3 TAPE-FITTED ISSUANCE: an issuance proxy fitted from price/tape alone; if it explains the anchor, the on-chain census adds nothing and dies.
X4 CLOCK/CALENDAR: Q-7 clock-only conditioning shadow + day-of-week geometry (the NG1 killer class).
X5 NULL VALIDITY: Q-11 delayed-state and shuffled nulls must MOVE the signal; INVALID-NULL verdicts explicit.
F1 COST CEILING (P-21): financing-inclusive worst-case round-trip ceiling measured at P2 on the frozen funding/cost bands.

netting_declaration.primary: Frozen C5 all-class series: SUM(Mint) - SUM(Burn) over ALL FiatToken minter classes, full-window, minter field validated by the flip check (topic1_distinct=5 <= topic2_distinct=117953). No class excluded from the anchor.
netting_declaration.V1_NEW_FLOAT_NET_outcome_blind: Declared variant: exclude the burns of 0x55fe002aeff02f77364de339a1292923a15844b8 from the 'new float' measure. A priori reason, stated from the frozen minter_table.json measured columns only (mint_n=0, mint=0.000000, burn_n=41737, burn=155547002051.641664 = 74.87% of all burned value in the window, class UNCLASSIFIED under the frozen two-sided dominance rule which did not fire): a single-address, one-sided pure-redemption stream at ~75% of burned weight makes the aggregate state substantially an address-level liability-management series rather than a market-wide float state; the variant isolates the multi-party mint/burn field. This is the ONLY address-level exclusion in this proposal; no exchange labels exist or are used (C5: label set NONE). Declared before any return was seen; consumed as a declared arm identity at S if it is carried forward.
netting_declaration.V2_CCTP_NETTED_outcome_blind: Declared variant per the frozen rule that CCTP share is a declared stratum enabling a CCTP-netted variant, never silently netted: remove the CCTP_TOKEN_MINTER class (0xfd78ee919681417d192449715b2594ab58f5d002; measured mint 54878352340.603395 / burn 26857185593.788332, class present) from both sides. Declared hypothesis (a priori, not a claim): cross-chain bridge settlement mechanics may differ from primary-market float creation. The anchor never silently nets CCTP in or out.
netting_declaration.variant_status: The anchor is the frozen all-class series. V1/V2 are sensitivity arms; if only a variant survives the veto battery, the anchor is dead and the variant must be re-declared as its own proposal consuming its own trial identity before any scored cell. Variants are not outcome-selected here: their machinery and thresholds are identical to the anchor and fixed a priori.
netting_declaration.chain_discipline: Issuer chains are NEVER summed into a silent stablecoin total: the state is USDC-ETHEREUM only (primary scored issuer). USDT-ETHEREUM (27 event days; 339 declared zero-event sparse days) and USDT-TRON (confirmed-channel stratum) are separate declared strata with zero weight in this proposal.
